author: medanasknan
name: god-rays-linear-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the God Rays style. Linear variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#050308, #4C1036, #E35D3E, #FFD166). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
